meta.title: Ondra Speech Rhythm
meta.description: Measures how the owner actually talks from the latest 300 human messages and compresses it into one roughly 55-character volatile block prefixed with the [语感] marker (handbook §1.8, O-137, P2). Four decisions are fixed. First, only shapes are stored, never the words: a message is reduced on arrival to sentence lengths, whether it carried punctuation, and trailing particle counts, and the raw text is dropped immediately, so the archive holds no utterance at all; remembering the shape but not the sentence is a structural fact rather than a promise. Second, only human turns are counted, never her own: assistant text is rejected outright, because counting her sentences makes her drift toward her own last reply while real changes in the owner get diluted. Third, the median is used instead of the mean: one pasted code block can drag the mean away, while the median only answers how long half of the sentences are. Fourth, the no-punctuation rate is counted per message, not per sentence, because per sentence it collapses into the same indicator as whether the whole message had punctuation. Below 30 samples the block is empty rather than a placeholder: a placeholder displaces real injections and gets read as information by the model. The text never states how many messages were counted, because the model would echo it back as a counter. This package does not rewrite the persona, does not build the system prompt, does not push into the eight injection blocks, calls no model, runs no timers and draws no interface: persona belongs to O-023, assembly to O-033, packing to O-036, and panels to the app shell.
